deploy-bot: Deploy finished: inference-api v2.14.0 rolled to canary (10%) in eu-west1, us-west2, ap-southeast1 :robot_face:
Alex: Noted. Kicking off post-deploy smoke probes.
infra-bot: Synthetic-scan started for route /v1/embeddings (probe_id: prb-9182)
Priya: ap-southeast1 probe showing elevated 5xx for embeddings, spike at 1808604355 :warning:
Alex: Can you grab logs / sample request/response?
infra-bot: logs snippet:
```json
{"region":"ap-southeast1","endpoint":"/v1/embeddings","status":502,"model_version":"redwood-mini-quant-v3"}
```
Jamie: hm model_version mismatch — canary should be running redwood-mini-quant-v2 in APAC due to routing pin. Could be a propagation/cache issue with routing policies.
Carlos: Is this causing user-facing errors? Any latency spike on client metrics?
Priya: Token-level telemetry shows increased error budget burn for embeddings in ap-southeast1 ~ +3% over the last 5m window. Not yet widespread but trending.
Alex: Immediate mitigation options: a) Fail canary in ap-southeast1 (rollback), b) Force route pin to v2 for ap-southeast1, c) Wait for more data. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Jamie: Prefer forcing routing pin, less disruptive than full rollback. I can push a routing override to edge quickly.
Priya: I'll hold canary scale-up in that region until we confirm. If Jamie can push pin, we'll rerun smoke.
Jamie: Pushing override now:
```bash
deployctl routing override --service inference-api --region ap-southeast1 --model redwood-mini-quant-v2 --reason "post-deploy embed probe mismatch"
```
infra-bot: Routing override applied (id: ro-2023-77) at 1808604520 :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: Re-running synthetic for /v1/embeddings in ap-southeast1
infra-bot: Probe results: success rate 99.6% (baseline 99.8%) latency stable
Priya: Error burn dropping, looks good. :relieved:
Alex: OK keep canary paused for 15m in ap-southeast1. We still need to figure out why canary had wrong model_version there. Jamie can you check rollout plan vs edge config?
Jamie: On it. Initial hypothesis: config propagation delay from model-catalog service during staged rollout. I'll open an issue and attach logs.
Carlos: Should we add a note to the release notes about the region-specific pin and the post-deploy anomaly? Also consider a follow-up postmortem if this repeats.
Alex: Yes. I'll add a short note and tag eng-releases. Also flag on-call for a 1:1 follow-up.
Priya: Final smoke across all regions is green. Re-enable canary scale after 15m if no regressions. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks team. Closing thread, capture follow-up in ticket INF-3219.
infra-bot: Ticket created INF-3219: investigate routing propagation for model catalog
